production.note: US model years for the S52-engined car. Cars.com and KBB list the car for 1999 (carscom-1999-bmw-m, kbb-1999-m-coupe) and period reviews of the "1999 BMW M Coupe" ran in January 1999 (curbside-1999-m-coupe). BMW NA's 5 January 2001 release introduces the "all-new 3.2 liter in-line six ... designated S54" car for 2001 (bmw-2001-m-coupe-release), so the S52 run ended with 2000. No opened page states in so many words that 1999 was the first US model year. The 2001-2002 S54 car is the separate record bmw-z3-m-coupe-e36-8-2001-2002.

body.note: Two-door hatchback-bodied coupe (KBB: "M Coupe 2D"); the open car is the separate M Roadster.

configuration.note: "3.2-liter, Straight 6 Cylinder Engine (Gasoline Fuel)" (the US S52)

displacementL.note: Sources state 3.2 liters; no cc figure was on any opened page.

aspiration.note: Inferred: no source describes a turbocharger or supercharger.

transmission.note: "5-Speed M/T"; manual only (John Matras: "the M Coupe is available only with a manual transmission", rememberroad-1999).

powerHp.note: PROVISIONAL source class (databases and period reviews; no BMW document could be opened). Quote (Cars.com, SAE Net Horsepower @ RPM): "240 @ 6000". KBB: "240 @ 6000 RPM" (kbb-1999-m-coupe). John Matras: "the big 3.2-liter six that cranks out a healthy 240 bhp at 6000 rpm and 236 lb-ft of torque" (rememberroad-1999); Adam Dixon's January 1999 review also lists "240 horsepower" (curbside-1999-m-coupe).

weightLb.note: PROVISIONAL source class (two agreeing databases). Quote (Cars.com): "Base Curb Weight" "3,131 lbs.". KBB: "3131 lbs." (kbb-1999-m-coupe). 5-speed manual, the only configuration offered.

provisionalNote: Power (240 hp) and weight (3,131 lb) rest on spec databases (Cars.com and KBB, agreeing) corroborated by period reviews, not on a BMW document or a major-magazine specification panel: no BMW NA page for the 1999-2000 M Coupe could be found or opened, and Car and Driver is blocked. A BMW NA press kit, brochure or technical-data sheet, or a C/D-class specification panel for the 1999-2000 M Coupe, would replace both.
